Gamification has a dashboard: points for the period and today, who is scoring, the top five, points by team and by measure, badges earned, challenges running and the last 14 days. Wallboards can show the leaderboard (today, this week or this month) under the tiles, with names only as the gamification settings allow.

Knowledge base articles can be deleted, one at a time or several ticked at once; deleted articles also leave the Untapped knowledge base.

More ready-made templates, for telecoms and IT support desks: fault-call and business-sales playbooks, a technical support and a sales consultation quality form, support and sales outcome sets, scripts (moving businesses off copper lines, backup power, fault follow-up), support and sales quick replies, and knowledge packs on connectivity faults, Yealink desk and cordless phones, packet captures and call quality, support policies, and supporting customers on a hosted contact centre. New call flow also offers a "log a fault" messaging bot.

Live monitor shows outbound calls in their own tiles: calls out now and dialled today.

Campaigns can be started, paused and resumed from the list. Carriers have a codec choice (G.711 A-law or µ-law first) and can be checked with SIP OPTIONS.

Platform → Tenants lists our own tenants and resellers' tenants apart.

Servers: call capacity is sized from the load test (50 calls a core), and media servers have room for thousands of call legs."}
